name: open-source-release R-6: AppImage GPL guard suite FAILS against a mutant build-appimage.sh whose GPL-library guard never fires
summary: Copy-out counterexample, so the shared tree was never mutated. The test resolves ../bin/build-appimage.sh from its own directory, so both files were copied to a temp tree and only the copy was mutated. The mutation turns the GPL-library guard (if [ -n "$_gpl_hits" ]) into if false, which lets a GPL-only library reach the AppDir without failing the build. The suite goes red (7 tests, 5 pass, 2 fail, exit 1). The failing tests are 'the guard fails the build when a GPL codec library reaches the AppDir' and 'D-013: the guard fails on each newly covered GPL library'. The unmutated copy in the same run passed 7/7, which gives a matched baseline. The mutant parses (bash -n ok).

assertions.evidence: node --test on the mutant: # tests 7, # pass 5, # fail 2, exit 1. not ok 2 and not ok 6 are the guard tests.
Same temp layout, unmutated copy: 7 pass, 0 fail, exit 0.
cmp reported the mutant differs from the original, and bash -n parsed the mutant.
